bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/original.py"
python3 - "$tmp/original.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,ast
s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
marker='"REQUEST_SIZE_INVALID",'
assert s.count(marker)==1
assert "INVITE_COPY_BUTTON_TYPE_MISMATCH" not in s[s.index('safe_codes = {'):]
s=s.replace(marker,marker+'\n                "INVITE_COPY_BUTTON_TYPE_MISMATCH", "INVITE_COPY_GATE_MISMATCH",\n                "DM_SELECTOR_SCREEN_NOT_OPENED", "CHAT_SELECTOR_URL_MISMATCH",',1)
ast.parse(s)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(s)
PY
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
if ! timeout 40s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1;then exit 72;fi
result="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
{
 echo "INVITE_SELECTOR_EXACT_TEST"
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_' | head -5 || true
 echo "ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
 echo "ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
